info.title: TRADING
info.description: Convert endpoints for the Coins.ph Trading API — covering quote fetching and acceptance.

post.description:
Returns all supported trading pairs available for the Convert feature.
Each pair includes the source and target currency, amount limits, and decimal precision.

---

## Additional Info

**Rate Limit** [📖 Learn More](https://api.docs.coins.ph/reference/general#api-limit-introduction)

Weight: 1

**Use Cases** [🧩 SDK](https://api.docs.coins.ph/reference/general#sdk)

- **Pre-conversion Validation** — Check if a desired currency pair is supported before requesting a quote
- **Limit Discovery** — Retrieve min/max source amounts to validate input before submitting

**Best Practices**

- Cache the response and refresh periodically; supported pairs change infrequently
- Use the `precision` field to format display amounts correctly for each pair
- Filter by `sourceCurrency` or `targetCurrency` client-side to reduce UI clutter

type.description:
Conversion type filter. If omitted, returns all supported trading pairs. Accepted values:

- `CONVERT` — Standard Convert mode
- `LIGHTNING` — Lightning Convert mode
- `LIGHTNING_WITHDRAW` — Lightning Withdraw mode
- `OTC` — OTC-Convert mode (whitelist-only feature, minimum trade size $20,000;
  contact otcdesk_ph@coins.ph to request access)

recvWindow.description: Request validity window in milliseconds. Default: 5000, Maximum: 60000.

signature.description: HMAC SHA256 signature of the query string [📖 Learn More](https://api.docs.coins.ph/reference/general#signed-endpoint-examples-for-post-openapiv1order)

sourceCurrency.description: The source currency of the trading pair.

targetCurrency.description: The target currency of the trading pair.

minSourceAmount.description: Minimum source amount allowed for conversion.

maxSourceAmount.description: Maximum source amount allowed for conversion.

precision.description: Decimal precision for the conversion amount.

default.description:
API error response. The `code` field contains the internal API error code (not an HTTP status code).

| Code | Description |
|---|---|
| -1100 | Illegal characters found in parameter |
| -1104 | Not all sent parameters were read |

For the full list of error codes, see [Error Codes](https://api.docs.coins.ph/reference/error-codes).

post.description:
Fetch a real-time conversion quote for a given currency pair and amount.

Provide either `sourceAmount` or `targetAmount`, but not both. The quote is valid
for the number of seconds specified in the `expiry` field of the response.

**Key Notes**

- The quote `quoteId` must be used with the Accept Quote endpoint before expiry.

---

## Additional Info

**Rate Limit** [📖 Learn More](https://api.docs.coins.ph/reference/general#api-limit-introduction)

Weight: 1

**Use Cases** [🧩 SDK](https://api.docs.coins.ph/reference/general#sdk)

- **Large Volume Conversion (OTC Mode)** — Enable high-value conversions through our OTC desk, offering dedicated liquidity and execution for trades above **$20,000**. Access is available to whitelisted users only.

**Best Practices**

- Fetch a new quote immediately before accepting; quotes expire quickly (see `expiry` field)
- Use `sourceAmount` for fixed-spend conversions; use `targetAmount` for fixed-receive conversions
- Leave the `type` parameter empty or omit it entirely to perform a standard Convert transaction. Set `type` to `OTC` to execute the conversion through OTC Mode (whitelisted users only).

sourceCurrency.description: The source currency for the conversion.

targetCurrency.description: The target currency for the conversion.

sourceAmount.description: Amount of source currency to convert. Provide this OR targetAmount, not both.

targetAmount.description: Amount of target currency to receive. Provide this OR sourceAmount, not both.

type.description:
Conversion type.

- `CONVERT` — Standard Convert mode (default)
- `LIGHTNING` — Lightning Convert mode
- `LIGHTNING_WITHDRAW` — Lightning Withdraw mode
- `OTC` — OTC-Convert mode (whitelist-only feature, minimum trade size $20,000;
  contact otcdesk_ph@coins.ph to request access)

recvWindow.description: Request validity window in milliseconds. Default: 5000, Maximum: 60000.

signature.description: HMAC SHA256 signature of the query string [📖 Learn More](https://api.docs.coins.ph/reference/general#signed-endpoint-examples-for-post-openapiv1order)

expiry.description: Number of seconds until this quote expires.

default.description:
API error response. The `code` field contains the internal API error code (not an HTTP status code).

| Code | Description |
|---|---|
| -1100 | Illegal characters found in parameter |
| -1102 | Mandatory parameter was not sent, was empty/null, or malformed |

post.description:
Accept a previously fetched conversion quote using its `quoteId`. The conversion
is executed immediately upon acceptance.

**Key Notes**

- The `type` parameter, if provided, must match the type used in the Get Quote request.
- Quotes expire after the number of seconds indicated by the `expiry` field in the quote response.

---

## Additional Info

**Rate Limit** [📖 Learn More](https://api.docs.coins.ph/reference/general#api-limit-introduction)

Weight: 1

**Use Cases** [🧩 SDK](https://api.docs.coins.ph/reference/general#sdk)

- **Instant Conversion** — Execute a currency swap immediately at the quoted rate
- **Two-Step Convert Flow** — Combine with Get Quote to build a confirm-then-execute UX
- **OTC Execution** — Accept large-volume OTC quotes by passing `type=OTC`

**Best Practices**

- Accept the quote immediately after confirming the rate to avoid expiry
- Store the returned `orderId` for reconciliation and support queries

quoteId.description: The quote ID returned from the Get Quote endpoint.

type.description:
Conversion type. Must match the type used when fetching the quote.

- `CONVERT` — Standard Convert mode (default)
- `LIGHTNING` — Lightning Convert mode
- `LIGHTNING_WITHDRAW` — Lightning Withdraw mode
- `OTC` — OTC-Convert mode (whitelist-only feature, minimum trade size $20,000;
  contact otcdesk_ph@coins.ph to request access)

recvWindow.description: Request validity window in milliseconds. Default: 5000, Maximum: 60000.

signature.description: HMAC SHA256 signature of the query string [📖 Learn More](https://api.docs.coins.ph/reference/general#signed-endpoint-examples-for-post-openapiv1order)

orderId.description: The order ID for the accepted conversion.

status.description:
The order status. Possible values are: `TODO`, `PROCESSING`, `SUCCESS`, and `FAILED`.
`TODO` means the order is ready to process (pending execution).
`PROCESSING` means the server is processing the order. `SUCCESS` means the order
has been completed successfully. `FAILED` means the order processing failed.
Please check the `errorMessage` field in the Order List API response for the
detailed failure reason.

default.description:
API error response. The `code` field contains the internal API error code (not an HTTP status code).

| Code | Description |
|---|---|
| 10000003 | Too many requests. Try again later. (This endpoint supports a minimum refresh interval of 1000 ms) |

For the full list of error codes, see [Error Codes](https://api.docs.coins.ph/reference/error-codes).

post.description:
Query the history of convert orders for the authenticated account.

**Key Notes**

- Maximum query window is 180 days.
- Default page size is 10; maximum is 200 records per page.

---

## Additional Info

**Rate Limit** [📖 Learn More](https://api.docs.coins.ph/reference/general#api-limit-introduction)

Weight: 1

**Use Cases** [🧩 SDK](https://api.docs.coins.ph/reference/general#sdk)

- **Conversion Audit** — Review all past conversions for a given time period
- **Reconciliation** — Match convert orders against balance changes for accounting

**Best Practices**

- Use `startTime` and `endTime` to narrow queries and avoid fetching large datasets
- Filter by `status=PROCESSING` to identify orders that may need follow-up
- Paginate using `page` and `size` rather than fetching all records at once

startTime.description: Start time filter in Unix milliseconds.

endTime.description: End time filter in Unix milliseconds.

status.description: Filter by order status. Possible values: `TODO`, `PROCESSING`, `SUCCESS`, `FAILED`. Please refer to [accept-quote API → order status] for the description of each status.

size.description: Number of records per page. Default: 10, maximum: 200.

type.description: Specifies the trading mode. Please refer to [get-quote API → type].

quoteId.description: Filter by quote ID. Please refer to [accept-quote API → quoteId].

orderId.description: Filter by order ID. Please refer to [accept-quote API → orderId].

recvWindow.description: Request validity window in milliseconds. Default: 5000, Maximum: 60000.

signature.description: HMAC SHA256 signature of the query string [📖 Learn More](https://api.docs.coins.ph/reference/general#signed-endpoint-examples-for-post-openapiv1order)

200.description: List of convert order history records.

total.description: Total number of records matching the query.

orderId.description: Order ID generated by the server. Please refer to [accept-quote API → orderId].

quoteId.description: Order reference quote Id. Please refer to [accept-quote API → quoteId].

status.description: Order status. Possible values: `TODO` (ready to process), `PROCESSING`, `SUCCESS`, `FAILED`. Please refer to [accept-quote API → order status] for the description of each status.

createdAt.description: Order creation time in Unix milliseconds.

errorMessage.description: Error message if the order failed.

errorCode.description: Error code if the order failed.
